properties.aiPrompt:
Canonicalize an OEM/electronics manufacturer's company name to its formal published form.

company_name: ${company_name}

Rules:
- Use the manufacturer's officially published name where you know it (e.g. "Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd.", "Texas Instruments Incorporated", "ON Semiconductor Corporation").
- Preserve standard legal-entity suffixes (Inc., Corp., Ltd., Co., Ltd., GmbH, AG, S.A., K.K.).
- Title-case ordinary words; keep brand-style capitalization (e.g. "STMicroelectronics", "onsemi", "NXP").
- Drop trailing commas, internal codes, parenthetical division names unless part of the legal name.
- If the input is already canonical, return it unchanged.
- If unsure, return the input cleaned of obvious junk (extra whitespace, trailing punctuation) and properly title-cased.

Output: a single line, no quotes

properties.name: Supplier Risk
properties.label: Supplier Risk
properties.description: Calculated supplier-risk roll-up. Score is a weighted penalty sum over sanctions hits, Kharon risk, expired/missing certifications, recent cyber breaches, FOCI status, and sourcing approval. Higher = riskier.

properties.name: Score
properties.label: Score
properties.description: 0–100, higher = riskier. Capped sum of: +40 any sanctions LISTED/SANCTIONED, +30 any Kharon risk above threshold, +20 per expired or missing relevant certification (capped at +40), +15 if any breaches in last 3 yrs, +10 if FOCI status = FOCI, +25 if preferred_sourcing = DEPRECATED.
properties.formula:
MIN(100,
            (IF(ANY([z2.sanctions.status], "LISTED") || ANY([z2.sanctions.status], "SANCTIONED"), 40, 0))
            + (IF([kharon.any_risk_above_threshold] = TRUE, 30, 0))
            + MIN(40, 20 * (
              IF([certifications.iso_9001.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_9001.status] = "Not Held", 1, 0)
              + IF([certifications.iso_14001.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_14001.status] = "Not Held", 1, 0)
              + IF([certifications.as9100.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.as9100.status] = "Not Held", 1, 0)
              + IF([certifications.iatf_16949.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iatf_16949.status] = "Not Held", 1, 0)
              + IF([certifications.iso_13485.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_13485.status] = "Not Held", 1, 0)
            ))
            + (IF([cyber.breach_history_recent_count] > 0, 15, 0))
            + (IF([ownership.foci_status] = "FOCI", 10, 0))
            + (IF([preferred_sourcing.status] = "DEPRECATED", 25, 0))
          )

properties.name: Band
properties.label: Band
properties.description: Bucketed score — LOW (<25), MEDIUM (25–49), HIGH (50–74), CRITICAL (>=75).

enumType.name: Risk Band
enumType.description: Score → band mapping. Applied to every `score` in every sub-area and the overview. <20 LOW, 20-39 MEDIUM, 40-69 HIGH, ≥70 CRITICAL.

properties.name: Dominant Factor
properties.label: Dominant Factor
properties.description: Single biggest contributor to the score — SANCTIONS / KHARON_RISK / EXPIRED_CERTS / CYBER_BREACH / FOCI / DISAPPROVED_SUPPLIER / NONE. Picked by largest weighted penalty.

enumType.name: Supplier Risk Dominant Factor
enumType.description: Why the supplier-risk band sits where it does — the single largest contributor to the score.

properties.formula:
IF(ANY([z2.sanctions.status], "LISTED") || ANY([z2.sanctions.status], "SANCTIONED"), "SANCTIONS",
                    IF([kharon.any_risk_above_threshold] = TRUE, "KHARON_RISK",
                    IF([preferred_sourcing.status] = "DEPRECATED", "DISAPPROVED_SUPPLIER",
                    IF([certifications.iso_9001.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_9001.status] = "Not Held"
                      || [certifications.iso_14001.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_14001.status] = "Not Held"
                      || [certifications.as9100.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.as9100.status] = "Not Held"
                      || [certifications.iatf_16949.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iatf_16949.status] = "Not Held"
                      || [certifications.iso_13485.status] = "Expired" || [certifications.iso_13485.status] = "Not Held", "EXPIRED_CERTS",
                    IF([cyber.breach_history_recent_count] > 0, "CYBER_BREACH",
                    IF([ownership.foci_status] = "FOCI", "FOCI", "NONE"))))))
